title: Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28137v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. Existing memory methods retain past content, yet they often fail at precise selective recall, returning the wrong appearance of a person, mixing different people, or keeping an unrequested background. Based on our analysis of memory form and retrieval, we introduce an object-aware key--value (KV) memory framework for a frozen autoregressive diffusion generator. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. translated_title: 选择什么回归：面向交互式视频生成中选择性召回的对象感知KV记忆
translated_abstract: 交互式长视频生成使用户能够通过连续的提示词构建故事，并在新指令下复用先前出现的角色与场景。现有记忆方法虽然能保留过去的内容，但在精确的选择性召回方面往往表现不佳，例如返回错误的人物外观、混淆不同的人物，或保留未被要求的背景。基于对记忆形式与检索机制的分析，我们为一个冻结的自回归扩散生成器提出了对象感知的键值（KV）记忆框架。该框架保留被跟踪对象区域的原始KV，通过注意力分数选取对象区域之外的背景KV，并将每条记忆与其来源场景及所观察外观的可读记录相关联。由大语言模型（LLM）选择所需的记录，再由记忆整合器在当前提示词下为生成过程提供相应的KV。我们还引入了包含六个场景的评估基准，用于测试选择性属性修改、特定时间外观召回等能力。
tldr: 提出对象感知KV记忆框架，通过保留对象区域的原始KV、用注意力分数筛选背景KV并结合LLM选择记忆记录，实现交互式视频生成中对先前角色与场景的精确选择性召回。
en_tdlr: We propose an object-aware KV memory framework that preserves original KVs of tracked object regions, selects background KVs via attention scores, and uses an LLM to pick memory records, enabling precise selective recall of earlier characters and settings in interactive video generation.
